answer: Each agent is a vertex that must lock its own stake before it can vote; watchdogs slash any bond reused by two accounts. A Sybil thus needs a separate lock per fake identity, so the delta in attack cost grows linearly with wallet count, erasing any gain from splitting one vote into many. Even an ocean of new accounts cannot dilute honest weight, because power tracks locked stake, not headcount: the attacker forfeits collateral on every fake he creates.
